reference_basis: Independent role clocks use measured load/composition strength. A role compares current public offered work, backlog/trend and deadline shortfall against its last joint-calculation reference. Only a material single-role change (or fresh evidence for an unresolved reversal) requests one joint target. No forced periodic joint review, dispatch replay, or post-result tuning. Existing .1 GPU change floor and 100-1000ms checks remain engineering settings, not proven optima.
